shortDescription: Schedule the execution of a command or script file via the at command

options.name: command
options.description: A command to be executed in the future.

options.name: count
options.description: The count of units in the future to execute the command or script file.

options.name: script_file
options.description: An existing script file to be executed in the future.

options.name: state
options.description: The state dictates if the command or script file should be evaluated as V(present) (added) or V(absent) (deleted).

options.name: unique
options.description: If a matching job is present a new job will not be added.

options.name: units
options.description: The type of units in the future to execute the command or script file.
